paragraphs: Rabbi Chananyah, son of Rabbi Aivu, Shir HaShirim Rabbah on “How beautiful are your steps.” Rabbi Yudan bar Aivu, Berakhot 2:4. Rabbah bar Aivu, Gittin 32a. Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Aivu, Yevamot 11:2.

notes.text: These are separate patronymic attestations. The Shir HaShirim verse incipit is retained without adding a modern verse number.
The consulted Yerushalmi passages name a son of Rabbi Aivu. Gittin 32a preserves an alternate reading with Rabbah bar Avuha. The exact Chananyah incipit remains Hyman’s report.
